paragraphs: Ascend Analytics sells market intelligence, expert services and proprietary analytics to companies making decisions from planning through operations. The audience it names is resource planners, developers, power buyers and investors. Utilities, community choice aggregators and retail providers are called out as well.

The forecasting product, AscendMI, publishes wholesale outlooks stretching 30 years and more for markets in the United States, Europe and Japan. It also forecasts retail rates in the United States, supporting community solar and storage, behind-the-meter projects and virtual power plants. PowerVAL is the valuation side, pulling siting, dispatch simulation and valuation for solar, storage, wind, hybrid and thermal assets into a single number. Underneath both, the software treats weather variability as a key predictor of renewables, load and price.

The company reports more than 250 current customers and says its platform fuels more than $50 billion in project financing assessments. Banking and finance institutions have relied on PowerVAL valuations for more than 100 project financings and acquisitions since 2020. Case studies name Austin Energy, which gained approval for a 2035 resource plan. It also runs an Ascend Summit in Boulder, set for September 30 to October 2, 2026.

quote.text: PowerVAL unifies siting, dispatch simulation, and valuation across solar, storage, wind, hybrid, and thermal assets into one defensible number.
